syllabusSource.title: PDEU course handout 2024-25 (CIVIL semester 3): Building Planning and Computer Aided Drawing Lab

topics.name: List out abbreviations and symbols used in building planning. (2 A-2 size sheet).
Draw a layout of different types of doors, windows, trusses and stairs used in building. (4 A-2 separate sheet for each component).
Draw typical layout of building principles (1 A-1 size sheet).
Draw typical layout of Plan – Section – Elevation for Single storied residential building ((1 A-1 size sheet).
Draw typical layout of Plan – Section – Elevation for Double storied residential building ((1 A-1 size sheet).
Draw typical layout of Plan – Section – Elevation for Public Building (Bank, School, Commercial Complex) (1 A-1 size sheet).
Draw a perspective drawing of building (1 A-1 size sheet).
Draw typical layout of Plan – Section – Elevation for Double storied residential building in Auto-CAD with basic commend (1 A-1 size sheet printed).
